_doc: Published values kept while the Parliament Members API reports a change that no independent source confirms yet. A hold applies only while the API still returns apiValue. Remove the entry once the change is corroborated or reversed. See scripts/fetch/fetch-mp-data.mjs.

holds.reason: The API reports Joani Reid as Labour. Wikipedia (Joani Reid, retrieved 4 October 2026) records her resigning the Labour whip on 5 March 2026 and no restoration. Unconfirmed, so the published value stands.
